title: A memory of the whole Home conversation: what was settled early stays in view, and what the person stated becomes the project's memory
request: Continue the Home plan after H4: Home must keep the whole conversation in mind, and hand what was settled to the project.
spec: Package H5 of the Home plan: a code-built summary of the draft (intent, confirmed fields, answers, open questions); the model's state becomes state + summary + the last 8 messages; on exit the summary and the confirmed brief go to project memory; a fact stated early survives a 30-message conversation.
plan: Build the summary from the draft's records alone, so it needs no model and claims nothing the records do not.
Show the model the summary and the last 8 messages instead of the last 12.
At a project's birth, write only what the person stated to the project's memory through the memory session's calls; agree the boundary with that session first.

decisions.decision: Only fields stated in the person's words become project memory; assumptions, defaults and guesses stay in the draft.
decisions.why: A remembered line is read by later agents as true; an assumption remembered as a fact would mislead them.

decisions.decision: The memory session's calls are used, not a second writer.
decisions.why: One writer keeps the memory's rules (one line, no secret, sourced) in one place; that session owns dclab_rnd/memory.

change: draft/memory.py (summary, recent, facts, hand_off); draft/chat.py (context gains the conversation's summary, model_turn uses the last 8 messages, built() hands off to project memory).

findings.defect: A test assertion that could never fail.
findings.scenario: The first version of the summary's number check ended in 'or True'.
findings.cause: Written to pass, not to test.
findings.fix: Every number in the summary must appear in the draft's records.

findings.defect: An early fact fell out of the model's view.
findings.scenario: A refresh settled in the second message was gone after thirty more messages.
findings.cause: The model saw only the last twelve messages.
findings.fix: The state carries the code-built summary of the whole conversation.

outcome: Home's model keeps everything the conversation settled in view however long it grows, and a project starts with what the person stated as its memory.
lessons: A test that cannot fail is worse than none: it reads as evidence.
risks: The memory session's brief is not yet read into Home's context: a follow-up package.
